reply_text:
I told Tobias in his DM that his standing call with the Marrow Agrisupply team is Thursdays at 10:45. That's what he told me on 14 October. He never gave a timezone; he was writing at -05:00, and I said so in the reply.

The answer comes from the note I saved from his own DM, so it's his information. I didn't use Dana Okafor's Quarrendon note that's now in memory too, and I didn't touch his calendar.
